description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmploymentStatusDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It tests various CRUD operations and search functionalities related to employment status entities in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmploymentStatusDao methods such as retrieving, deleting, searching, and saving employment statuses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of EmploymentStatusDao and populating test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusesList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of employment statuses and expects exactly 3 results.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employment status by ID and verifies its name.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple employment statuses by IDs and checks the count of remaining entries.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests searching employment statuses with default filter parameters and verifies the count and type of returned objects.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatusWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employment statuses with a limit set in filter parameters.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new employment status, then verifies the saved object.

methods.name: testEditEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employment status and verifies the updates.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatuses
methods.description: Another test for retrieving employment statuses, similar to testGetEmploymentStatusesList.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Tests counting employment statuses based on search filter parameters.
